title: Dependency Updates
meta: We update outdated libraries and frameworks in your app and test that it still works. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Dependency updates that keep your app current and safe
overview: Old libraries slow you down and leave security holes open. We audit what your app uses, update what is safe to update and test after each step so nothing breaks quietly. Risky upgrades, such as a major framework version, are handled on a separate branch with a rollback plan. You get a list of what changed, what we left alone and why, and what to schedule next.

A full tidy-up with update alerts and an upgrade roadmap.

faq: Which languages and package managers do you cover?
npm, yarn and pnpm for JavaScript, pip and Poetry for Python, Composer for PHP, Bundler for Ruby, and Gradle or Maven for Java. Tell us your stack in the form and we confirm before starting.
What if an update breaks something?
Each step is a separate commit, so we can undo one without losing the rest. If a package cannot be updated safely, we leave it, explain why and suggest an alternative.
Do you need tests to exist already?
It helps, but it is not required. Without tests we check the build, the main screens and key flows by hand on staging. We recommend adding a few tests first if the app has none.
Will you upgrade the framework itself?

Minor versions are in every package. Major framework upgrades, such as Rails, Laravel or Angular, are in the Standard and Premium packages, within the limits shown. Very large jumps may need a separate order.
